name: How do I know if a ceiling crack is cosmetic or structural?
description: Cosmetic cracks follow drywall seams and remain narrow. Cracks that widen, cause sagging, or reappear quickly after repair suggest structural framing movement.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a ceiling crack is cosmetic or structural?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hairline cracks along straight lines usually stem from standard building settling or thermal expansion along drywall seams. While cosmetic cracks can be taped and re-mudded, cracks paired with downward deflection, popping fasteners, or widening gaps often point to structural movement or truss uplift. If the crack reappears shortly after being patched, having a licensed general contractor inspect the overhead framing and attic load paths is necessary to determine if structural reinforcement is required before re-finishing.
